jobs.title: Founding Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CORRIDOR

Software development is becoming autonomous. The fastest teams already work this way, and at Corridor, we are leading the way on secure development as the rest of the industry follows.

Security tools were designed for a world where a person wrote the code and a person reviewed it. That's changing quickly. Corridor is securing software factories. We are the security solution for software that builds itself at every level of autonomy. We are preventing vulnerabilities as agents write code, and guiding teams to help decide what's safe to ship.

Led by Jack Cable https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackcable/ (Former CISA - Secure by Design) and Ashwin Ramaswami https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashwin-r/ (Former CISA, Stanford, and Schmidt Futures).

Corridor is backed by Conviction, with a $25M Series A led by Felicis and our customers include ElevenLabs, Lovable, Mercor, and Langchain.

The Role

We’re looking for a high-ownership Product Marketing Manager to help define how Corridor goes to market as we build a new category in AI security. You’ll own our positioning, messaging, launches, and customer-facing narrative - working closely with customers and across Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership to turn a complex technical product into something the market understands and wants to buy.


What You’ll Do

 - Define how Corridor is positioned, understood, and differentiated as we build a new category in AI security. Turn complex technical concepts into clear, compelling stories for security, infrastructure, developer, and AI teams.

 - Own competitive intelligence across the AI security market - tracking competitors, product capabilities, and launches, and turning those insights into clear messaging, battlecards, and guidance for Sales and GTM teams.

 - Stay close to customers and prospects to understand their problems, language, buying decisions, and highest-value use cases. Bring those insights directly into Product, Sales, Marketing, and company strategy.

 - Create and ship the work that helps customers understand and buy Corridor — from website content and sales decks to case studies, messaging, launches, and other customer-facing assets.

 - Own the narrative, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for new products and capabilities, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.

 - Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape, legacy security approaches, and emerging alternatives. Turn that knowledge into sharp differentiation and a compelling customer story.

 - Test and iterate across positioning, messaging, launches, and demand generation. Use customer feedback and data to quickly double down on what works and cut what doesn’t.

 - Identify recurring customer problems, high-value use cases, and unmet needs and help shape what we build around the problems customers urgently need solved.


Who You Are

 - A high-ownership PMM and builder who can go deep on a technical product and move quickly from strategic insight to execution.

 - You’ve been a first or early PMM, or held a similarly high-ownership GTM role at a high-growth startup.

 - You’ve marketed a technical product, ideally across AI, cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, or a related space.

 - You can earn credibility with technical buyers and engineers, while translating complexity into messaging that is simple, compelling, and commercially effective.

 - You’re equally comfortable talking to customers, developing strategy, writing copy, building a deck, shaping a launch, and shipping the work yourself.

 - You have exceptional writing and communication skills and know how to turn a complicated product into a story people understand and want to buy.

 - You’re deeply customer-obsessed and naturally look for the underlying problem, not just the feature or request.

 - You’re intellectually curious, opinionated, and willing to change your mind when the evidence says you should.

 - You thrive in ambiguity, move quickly without a playbook, and have a strong bias toward action, ownership, and measurable impact.

 - You have 4+ years of experience in Product Marketing, GTM, Product, or a related role, with a track record of building positioning, messaging, ICPs, and GTM strategy from scratch.

 - You’ve personally created and shipped high-quality marketing and sales materials and worked closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership.



Equal Opportunity

Corridor is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We're looking for someone open to working in a hybrid environment 3 days per week in our South Beach, San Francisco office (Mon, Wed, Fri).

jobs.description:
ABOUT CORRIDOR

Software development is becoming autonomous. The fastest teams already work this way, and at Corridor, we are leading the way on secure development as the rest of the industry follows.

Security tools were designed for a world where a person wrote the code and a person reviewed it. That's changing quickly. Corridor is securing software factories. We are the security solution for software that builds itself at every level of autonomy. We are preventing vulnerabilities as agents write code, and guiding teams to help decide what's safe to ship.

We're a small, talented team, led by Jack Cable https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackcable/ (Former CISA - Secure by Design) and Ashwin Ramaswami https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashwin-r/ (Former CISA, Stanford, and Schmidt Futures).

Corridor is backed by Conviction, with a $25M Series A led by Felicis, and our customers include ElevenLabs, Lovable, Mercor, and Langchain.



SUMMARY

As a Product Manager, you'll own part of Corridor's product end to end. You'll talk to customers, frame the problem, prototype, and ship the product. You’ll be responsible for ensuring that the product brings value to users.

Our users are all technical: security engineers, platform teams, and the developers shipping AI-generated code. Your instinct for how engineers think and work matters greatly. This role works closely with engineering.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a scoped area of the product from problem framing through prototyping, rollout, and measurement

 - Ship and experiment fast: try ideas with customers, keep what sticks, drop what doesn't

 - Talk directly with security engineers, platform teams, and developers, and translate what you learn into clear product direction

 - Use AI relentlessly to prototype and speed up your own work and help the whole team do the same

 - Turn ambiguous, technical problems into simple, well-reasoned specs that engineering, customers, and leadership can all act on

 - Enable anyone at Corridor to experiment with product functionality while holding a clear point of view on what customers actually need

 - Establish a lightweight operating cadence that makes decisions, tradeoffs, dependencies, owners, and progress visible to the entire builder team. Everyone should understand what we’re building, why it matters, what comes next, and when or why the plan changes.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Technical background: you can read code, reason about systems, and hold your own in a technical conversation with engineers. An engineering degree, meaningful side projects, open-source contributions, or self-taught depth all count

 - Self-starter who loves to learn: you make progress on hard, under-specified problems without waiting to be told what to do, and you course-correct fast

 - Fluency with AI tools: you already reach for AI to get more done, and you want to automate as much of your own job as possible

 - Excellent communication: you make complex technical topics simple and persuasive, in writing and verbally

 - High agency and high urgency: you own problems end to end and ship quickly

 - Operating in ambiguity: you can turn ambiguous goals into priorities with clear outcomes, scope, owners, acceptance criteria, and measures of success.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Security, developer tools, or AI coding background

 - Experience building evals or benchmarks

 - Founder or startup background

 - Experience shipping a product from scratch



EQUAL OPPORTUNITY


Corridor is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
